out_of_time.design: features from months <= 2024-12; outcome = any negative-balance day in 2025; accounts with >= 12 months history

trough.definition: lowest end-of-day balance / average daily balance over the last 6 months
trough.population: complete records in both years; never below zero before the predicted year

no_shock_vs_shock.note: With no shock almost every account shows 'no shortfall', so the runway can't rank them; under the EI stress test it can.

confounders.model: statsmodels Logit: first overdraft in 2025 ~ bottom-10% trough flag + log(avg balance, Jul-Dec 2024) + months of history to Dec 2024 + district unemployment 2023
confounders.population: complete 2024 and 2025, never below zero before 2025 (same as trough by_year 2025)

did_not_survive: Trough beats Lowest balance, last 6 months (2025)

sim_calibration.design: Platt (logistic on logit of raw simulated P(break in 12 months), no shock); fit 2023-12 -> 2024, validate 2024-12 -> 2025

2023-12.population: 12+ months of history, never overdrawn up to asof, full next year

buffer.rule: engine.cushion: buffer = typical in-month dip (median of avg - min balance, last 12 months)

alert.rule: month-end balance below the customer's own alert_level, before the first overdraft

2024-12.population: 12+ months of history, never overdrawn up to asof, full next year

buffer.rule: engine.cushion: buffer = typical in-month dip (median of avg - min balance, last 12 months)

alert.rule: month-end balance below the customer's own alert_level, before the first overdraft

self_correction.design: real vs the customer's own months in random order (30 shuffles); months <= Dec of the year before; low month = month-end balance in the customer's own bottom 20% (or 30%)
self_correction.verdict: Steering back after a low holds in both years and cutoffs. Weak steering predicting overdrafts within the riskiest 10% is significant in 2025 but not in 2024 (and reverses at the 30% cutoff): not claimed.

segment.population: 2025 cohort: complete 2024+2025, never overdrawn before 2025; traits from data up to Dec 2024
segment.effect_rule: big = significant and practically large (amounts >= 25% apart; yes/no shares >= 1.5x and >= 5 points apart)

rows.trait: share of money in that is cash

segment.note: Descriptive, not causal. Own BH family (q = 0.10): these describe the flagged group rather than test a prediction.

loan_policy.rule: hold for review if, on data before the loan month, the applicant was ever overdrawn or is in the riskiest 10% of all customers by trough (12+ months to score)
loan_policy.note: Review means talk first (smaller loan, cushion, alert), not reject. Dollars are amounts lent, not losses.

rows.metric: Trough score drift (PSI, Dec 2023 vs Dec 2024)
Data quality: money in/out parts add up
Data quality: missing or negative values

monitoring.note: OSFI E-23 (effective May 1, 2027) asks for monitoring with defined breach thresholds; it sets no numbers. These thresholds are stated choices; a breach triggers re-validation.

diagnoses.design: Population: never overdrawn, 12+ months, full next year. Flag = riskiest 10% by trough at Dec of the prior year. Each group compared with flagged customers without it (one-sided Fisher). Thresholds fixed in engine.py.

combined_model.note: Logit on trough + money-in drop + swings + new-loan burden, fit 2023->2024, judged on 2025
combined_model.verdict: not adopted: no extra catches; used as reasons and actions instead

income_drop.label: Money in fell >= 25% (last 3 vs prior 9 months)

new_loan.label: New loan payment >= 30% of money in

swing.label: Cash flow swings (sd of net flow / balance >= 0.47)

rejected_bill_timing.label: Fixed bills leave before the main deposit (>= 75% of months)
